description: This source file defines a custom exception class `LoanCollateralAmountNotSufficientException` used within the collateral management component of the Fineract project. It extends a platform-specific exception to indicate insufficient collateral amount during loan disbursement.

classes.name: LoanCollateralAmountNotSufficientException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that the collateral amount provided for a loan disbursement is insufficient.

methods.name: LoanCollateralAmountNotSufficientException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific disbursement amount, passing a formatted error message to the superclass.
